_comment: SHARED text-prompt modal (scenes/shared/ — Aaron 2026-08-14 ruling 2A3592D0): rename / new-folder / name-this. The confirm.scene.json shape with ONE `text_field` between the body copy and the OK / Cancel pair. Text entry is the walker-owned SESSION (E559B955): the field declares `submit_action` / `cancel_action`, so Enter and Esc leave the session through the SAME fired names the two buttons fire — the modal never reads a raw key. Its edited text rides its `bind` (`modal_text`) and comes back on the results, which `SharedModal` carries out as the close PAYLOAD. The host supplies the seed text through the Model and the field's `kind` / `max_len` as component-prop overrides (the `arrange()` prop channel), both from the typed `ModalParams`. NO `behaviour` key (the manifest skips scenes/shared/); NO pair script (the params ARE the arrangement); chrome styles ride Main.scene.json's carrier through `main_scene_styles()`.
